user.title: What do you want to add?

menu_options.tank: A tank (feed mode, water changes, lights…)
menu_options.speeds: A Speed card (pump readouts + off timers)
menu_options.equipment: An Equipment status card (dosers, ATO, heaters…)
menu_options.maintenance: A maintenance task (fleece roll, ATO reset…)
menu_options.redsea: A RedSea task (ReefMat fleece / ATO reset)

speeds.title: New Speed card entry
speeds.description: Pumps to watch and control on the Speed card — each shows its speed (or on/off for a plug) with an Off button and an off-for-X-minutes timer. Add as many of these entries as you like.

data_description.name: Shown on the card — e.g. "Display Tank Pumps".
data_description.slug: Leave blank and it's created from the name automatically.
data_description.speed_displays: Number/fan entities show their speed; plain switches (e.g. a pump on a TP-Link Tapo plug) show on/off. Every pump gets the card's Off button and timer.

tank.title: New tank
tank.description: Give your tank a name. In the next step you'll pick which pumps, wavemakers, and skimmer belong to it.

data_description.name: Shown on your dashboards — e.g. "Main Display Tank".
data_description.slug: Leave blank and it's created from the tank name automatically. This short word starts every entity ID for this tank (e.g. "reef" gives button.reef_start_feed) so multiple tanks never clash. Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only, starting with a letter.

light.title: New light timer
light.description: A tap-to-run timer for lights (or anything switchable — e.g. a smart plug running LED strips). Add as many of these as you like, one per light circuit.

data_description.name: Shown on your dashboards — e.g. "Stand Lights".
data_description.slug: Leave blank and it's created from the name automatically.
data_description.lights: The switch, light, or fan entities this timer controls together. The Light timer slider sets how long they stay on; 0 keeps them on until you tap Lights off.

hardware.title: Tank hardware
hardware.description: Pick this tank's equipment. Any brand works as long as the device shows up in Home Assistant as a switch or fan. The last two fields are optional — leave them empty if they don't apply.

data_description.wavemakers: Paused during feeding and water changes.
data_description.skimmers: Paused during feeding (with an extra settling buffer) and water changes.
data_description.return_pumps: Paused during water changes; restarted first.
data_description.pump_speed_controls: Optional. If your return pump's speed is adjustable in Home Assistant, pick the control here — a number entity, or the pump's fan entity if power and speed are combined. Feed mode lowers the speed and restores it automatically.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional. A sensor that shows when mains/UPS power is on — enables a delayed skimmer restart after a power cut, so it doesn't foam over.
data_description.lights: Optional. Lights (or anything switchable — e.g. a Tapo plug running LED strips) you want a tap-to-run timer for. The Light timer slider sets how long they stay on; 0 keeps them on until you tap Lights off.
data_description.speed_displays: Optional. Extra pumps to show on the Speed card. Number/fan entities show their speed; plain switches (e.g. a pump on a Tapo plug) show on/off — and every pump gets the card's Off button and timer. Feed-mode speed controls are always shown automatically.
data_description.equipment: Optional. Extra devices for the Equipment status card — dosers, ATO, heaters… (switches, sensors, binary sensors, numbers).

equipment.title: New Equipment status entry
equipment.description: Devices to watch on the Equipment status card — dosers, ATO, heaters, chillers, anything. Switchable gear gets On/Off buttons, sensors show their reading, and anything that drops off the network is flagged. Add as many of these entries as you like.

data_description.name: Shown on the card — e.g. "Sump Equipment".
data_description.slug: Leave blank and it's created from the name automatically.
data_description.equipment: Switches, fans, lights, sensors, binary sensors, or numbers — e.g. a doser's pump switch, the ATO's run-dry sensor, a heater's plug, a temperature probe.

maintenance.title: New maintenance task
maintenance.description: A repeatable 'mark it done' task with a time-since counter — e.g. changing the filter-roller fleece, resetting an ATO after a dry run, swapping filter socks. Add one entry per task.

data_description.name: e.g. "Fleece Roll" or "ATO Reset".
data_description.slug: Leave blank and it's created from the name automatically.
data_description.maintenance_actions: Entities to trigger when you tap Done — e.g. the filter roller's new-roll button or the ATO's reset/fill switch from your equipment's integration. Leave empty for a log-only task (Done just stamps the date).
data_description.maintenance_status: A sensor to watch on the card — e.g. the ATO's run-dry sensor or the roller's position sensor.

redsea_mat.title: ReefMat — new fleece roll
redsea_mat.description: Pickers here only list entities from your RedSea ReefBeat integration. Link the ReefMat's new-roll control so tapping Done starts the new roll and stamps the change date.

data_description.slug: Leave blank and it's created from the name automatically.
data_description.maintenance_actions: The ReefMat control that starts a new roll (a button/switch/number on its device page). Leave empty for a log-only tracker.
data_description.maintenance_status: e.g. the roll position / near-end sensor, shown live on the Maintenance card.

redsea_ato.title: ReefATO+ — dry-run reset
redsea_ato.description: Pickers here only list entities from your RedSea ReefBeat integration. Link the ATO's reset/fill control so tapping Done clears a dry-run and stamps when it happened.

data_description.slug: Leave blank and it's created from the name automatically.
data_description.maintenance_actions: The ATO control that resets it / triggers a fill (a button/switch on its device page). Leave empty for a log-only tracker.
data_description.maintenance_status: e.g. the run-dry or water-level sensor — the Maintenance card shows it live and highlights it red when it's flagging.

error.invalid_slug: Couldn't make a valid prefix from that — use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores, starting with a letter (e.g. "reef" or "frag_2").

abort.already_configured: A tank with this entity ID prefix already exists — pick a different prefix (or tank name).

init.title: Rewire tank hardware
init.description: Change which devices this tank controls — e.g. swap practice/demo entities for real hardware. Your settings sliders and history are kept.
